test_clgen_dataset_size: test the CLgen dataset to verify it contains exactly 996 benchmarks
test_clgen_missing_benchmark_name: test that CLgenDataset raises LookupError when no benchmark name is specified in the URI
test_clgen_random_select: test randomly selecting benchmarks from the CLgen dataset and writing OpenCL kernel sources to a directory
run_clgen_test_suite: run the pytest test suite for the CLgen dataset using the main entry point
review_clgen_dataset_fixture: review the clgen_dataset pytest fixture that creates an LLVM environment and retrieves the benchmark://clgen-v0 dataset
